name: Mikel
title: Junior DAM Developer
summary: Passionate junior developer with hands-on experience building digital solutions using Python, FastAPI, and modern web technologies. Eager to contribute to meaningful projects while continuously expanding technical skills.

highlights: Built InterviewTTS, a voice-based AI portfolio that lets recruiters pre-interview candidates via voice interaction
Developed REST APIs using FastAPI with async processing and proper error handling
Implemented speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines using Whisper and Edge TTS
Created RAG-powered context retrieval for accurate, personalized responses

projects.name: InterviewTTS
projects.description: Voice-based AI portfolio that allows recruiters to have voice conversations with a digital twin of the candidate. Uses RAG over candidate documents to generate context-aware responses.
highlights: Full STT pipeline: browser recording → Whisper transcription
RAG pipeline with cosine similarity retrieval over candidate documents
Real-time voice synthesis using Edge TTS
Clean, professional frontend with microphone UI

stories.situation: Recruiters often spend 15-20 minutes on initial screening calls that could be automated
stories.task: Build a system that lets candidates create voice-based digital twins for automated pre-screening
stories.action: Designed and implemented a voice AI pipeline combining Whisper for STT, RAG for context retrieval, and Edge TTS for natural voice output
stories.result: Created InterviewTTS — a working MVP that enables voice conversations with a candidate's digital twin, reducing initial screening time
